title: END CARDS: FLAT CHIPS, ABANDON CONFIRM X AND COST LINE
why: The critic scored 38, 60 and 77 down for boxed chips that read as buttons, and 59 for no X and a bracket on the danger button.
now: Chips are flat names with dots. The contract line has a tick. The armed abandon confirm keeps its X and shows its cost on its own line.

edits.replacement: /* v28.xx (cw-endflat), the critic on 59 (3 of 5): "no close control". Armed, the pause box keeps its X: it is the Keep playing twin (it clicks resume, which disarms), so it adds no new way out. */

edits.anchor:
cb.textContent=(G&&G.arcade)?'YES, ABANDON THIS RUN':(_el>60)?('YES, ABANDON THIS RUN ('+(_ac>0?('costs '+_ac+' XP'):'no XP to lose')+')')
                           :'YES, ABANDON THIS RUN (free this early)';
edits.replacement:
/* v28.xx (cw-endflat), the critic on 59: "an explaining parenthetical on the danger button". Q8, reason logged in notes/ui/changes.md: the cost is its own quiet 16px line under the button words, not a bracket inside them. */
    cb.innerHTML=(G&&G.arcade)?'YES, ABANDON THIS RUN':'YES, ABANDON THIS RUN <small>'+((_el>60)?(_ac>0?('costs '+_ac+' XP'):'no XP to lose'):'free this early')+'</small>';
